entities.ticket_summary: Customers report invoice disputes and repeated refund requests after duplicate charges.
New customers ask setup questions and request import guidance during their first week.
Teams describe broken webhooks and intermittent authentication failures after deployment changes.
Users ask for login resets and device re-verification when access tokens expire.
Strategic accounts raise renewal risk and procurement delays tied to custom contract clauses.
Shoppers complain about delayed refunds damaged shipments and missing replacement updates.
